identity.description: Identity transaction - signing the public key

anchor.description: Handoff state anchor - hashes-only digest of an off-chain event (message/activity/task/settlement). Carries no value; sealed as a leaf block by its hash. TYPE-7 POINTER (code 7): xid micromines {from:[prior anchor xid]|[], to:[hash], how:'anchor'}; `prior` ("" for the first) travels with it so any holder can re-mine the identity.

tx.description: Type-6 value unit (paid activity: task.created/verified/settlement; enriched-type-6 per operator 2026-07-26). Content-addressed via shared micromining (xid carries the '06' prefix over the 8-field canonical body). from=[payer], to=[payee], amount=decimal-string, unspent=immutable denomination-at-mint (fungible=spendable value consumed by a type-7 how='spend' pointer, non-fungible=whole unit, ''=non-value payment record). The validatable value-tx that feeds the cube pipeline (e49408b7 tx-starvation cure). No sig in-body — payer sig is a separate type-7 pointer, deferred to layer-b; interim authorization is the settler's already-signature-authenticated verified-task gate.

typeRule: EVERY TRANSACTION HAS AN XMBL TYPE, SIGNIFIED BY ITS XID (operator, 2026-09-16). xid = SHA256(oid + nonce) where oid = SHA256(JSON.stringify({data})) over the type's canonical body, and the xid's first two hex chars are '0' + code. A transaction without a verifiable xid is untyped and is refused at every door (validateTransaction, consensus ingress, ledger admission, boot rehydration, canonical rebuild). Bodies: 'tx' = type6TxBody; 'anchor' = the type-7 pointer body; every other type = its own fields minus the envelope (sig, publicKey, xid, nonce, id, validationTimestamp[s]) with keys sorted.
authorityRule: AUTHORIZATION, stage 1 of consensus validation (operator: signed by a sender, OR content-addressed). authority='signed': the tx must carry a sig and a sender — a node-authored or user-authored datum whose authority is its signature. authority='content-addressed': the tx carries no in-body signature by design and its authority IS its xid (stage 2) — type 6 (the payer's sig is the deferred type-7 pointer) and type 7 (an anchor is a pointer to a digest: it moves no value, its body is {from:[prior],to:[hash],how:'anchor'}, and the broker that mints it is node-less and custodial, so no end user ever signs it). A content-addressed type is admitted UNSIGNED at ingress and is still refused if its xid does not verify.
